claim: Photonic computing research is moving part of the learning loop onto the physical device itself, making fabrication-aware optimization part of the learning mechanism.
verifiedFacts: Nature Computational Science published INSPIRE Oct. 5 for in-situ physical gradient descent on photonic integrated circuits.
The paper addresses fabrication-induced error and costly physical modeling.
inference: Inferred: compiler, hardware characterization and learning are becoming more coupled.
Inferred: governed receipts could capture hardware-conditioned parameters and fabrication state.
Unknown: commercial energy and scale advantage.
significance: Creates a research bridge between governed generative compilers, fabrication evidence and physical-compute learning.
assumptions: A bounded simulation can communicate evidence architecture without claiming hardware reproduction.
knownLimitations: No deployment economics or scale evidence.
